show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Reed Hastings - Building Netflix - [Invest Like the Best, EP.453]
summary: The first is this notion of finding a simple idea and taking it extraordinarily seriously. Netflix has effectively been scaling up its core original model since its inception. Reed talks in our conversation about how even the DVDs were nothing but a stepping stone towards the streaming future that they envisioned at the very outset of the company's founding in 1997.

reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Reed Hastings, the co-founder and former longtime CEO of Netflix.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Reed Hastings, the co-founder and former longtime CEO of Netflix. Netflix is an example of two ideas that everyone talks about, but are extremely hard to do in practice. The first is finding a simple idea and taking it extraordinarily seriously.

key_points.text: Reed talks about how even the DVD business was nothing more than a stepping stone toward streaming.
The second is talent density, and what it actually takes to set and sustain an exceptionally high bar over decades as a company grows.
We talk about how those ideas shaped Netflix’s culture and strategy, what Reed learned from mistakes like Qwikster.
